_readme: Data for build/gen_assets.py. style_block, negative_block and templates are the art bible's (docs/Nani jo Ghar — Art Bible.md, section 9) with sharper camera wording for top-down items and hands; every prompt = style_block + template + negative_block. Paths are relative to the repo root; reference_images may point into the git-ignored sources/private/. RULE (art bible section 8): edit mode is only for small changes to the SAME object -- hand poses from the signed-off reference hand, reskins, adding an item into an empty station background. Item STATES (whole -> chopped, raw -> fried, ...) are always mode 'generate' with their own full prompt, never an edit of another state: a state change is a complete transformation that edit mode does not carry across. States match each other only through the shared style block, view wording and colour words.
style_block: Stylised 3D animated-feature-film look: soft global illumination, gentle warm fill, believable materials (marble, brushed steel, polished brass, pale oak, cotton, food with soft subsurface), clean simplified surfaces with restrained detail, appealing slightly chunky proportions, no outlines. Warm late-morning sunlight from the upper left; soft shadows falling to the lower right; a soft contact shadow wherever something touches a surface. Bright, warm, clean palette. Match the rendering of the attached style reference exactly.

templates._comment: Templates follow art bible section 9 (c) item, (e) hand pose, (f) reskin. {style} and {negative} are filled automatically. Hands (round 3, 24 Sept 2026): warm light tan skin (not orange, not saturated), slender hand with long fingers, no bones/knuckles/veins, plain white linen sleeve rolled back between elbow and wrist.

fields.detail: Seen from straight above, the onion reads as a perfect round circle: glossy deep purple-red papery skin with faint pale lines radiating from the centre, the small dry tip at the centre of the circle; no side view, no root tuft visible.

fields.item: small loose pile of chopped red onion
fields.detail: Small curved, translucent, layered pieces of red onion: thin crescent-shaped slivers and small flat squares of single onion layers, each only 2-3 mm thick, lying flat so we see their broad top faces; glossy, juicy, translucent pale violet-white flesh with a thin deep magenta edge along the outer curve, some pieces showing two or three thin stacked layers. A loose, low, roughly round pile about 9 cm across, seen from directly above. Not cubes, not blocks, not two-tone candy, not solid.

assets._comment: A state: generated fresh, never edited from onion-whole (art bible section 8).

negative_block: Do not add any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. No outlines, no cel shading, no flat vector style, no painterly brushwork, no photorealism. No depth-of-field blur, motion blur, vignette, lens flare or bloom. No second light source. No extra objects, props, people or background clutter beyond what is described. Correct anatomy: five fingers per hand. No bindi, tilak or other Hindu religious markers.
